Description

This mixed lot includes 14 assorted pipes, each featuring a range of shapes, materials, and finishes. Styles present include both straight and curved stems, with bowl materials appearing to be primarily wood and one with a lighter, possibly meerschaum, finish. Several stems and bowls show notable signs of wear, chipping, or separation, making these ideal candidates for repair or repurposing.
Whether you're rebuilding classic pieces, sourcing parts, or simply appreciate the craftsmanship of traditional pipes, this assorted lot offers intriguing visual appeal and variety. The lot's visible condition ranges broadly, with some pipes intact and others suited for parts or display only. Please note: all pipes are pre-owned and sold as is, with visible chips, cracks, and missing pieces on several items as shown in the images. No additional accessories are included. 278503346.description: This vintage mid-century pipe smoker's set includes a cork and brass base, a brass lidded tobacco jar showing visible patina and oxidation inside, a wooden and plastic smoking pipe, and two brass pipe rests. The brass components display tarnish and wear consistent with age, and the pipe shows signs of use. The cork base has pads on the underside for stability. The set features classic mid-century modern design elements and visible flaws include patina inside the jar and tarnish on the brass parts.
